_note: Single source of truth for every gallery on the site. build.py renders the grids, the collection cards and the ImageGallery/ImageObject schema from this file. To publish a real photograph, drop the file into images/ and change that entry's src, w and h - nothing else moves. Alt text is written for the photograph that belongs at each slot; see README.md 'Before launch' before the site goes public with placeholder plates still in place.

collections.title: Weddings
collections.blurb: Two or three days, photographed the way they actually happen. No posing lines, no held-up bouquets.

collections.title: Portraits
collections.blurb: An unhurried hour, usually outdoors, usually near the end of the day. You end up with pictures that look like you.

collections.title: Film & motion
collections.blurb: A short film cut from sound as much as picture. Vows, speeches, the room going quiet.

collections.title: Editorial & brand
collections.blurb: Rooms, makers and products, lit so the work is the subject and the photograph gets out of the way.
